crossrefs.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
During the days of Jesusʼ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them. They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

Then Saulʼs anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you? For as long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom shall be established. Now send for him and bring him to me, for he must surely die!” “Why must he be put to death?” Jonathan replied. “What has he done?” Then Saul hurled his spear at Jonathan to kill him. So Jonathan knew that his father was determined to kill David.
